<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="22" x2="320" y2="28" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="28" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="16" x2="330" y2="28" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- avatar -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="158" r="43" fill="#DCEFF7"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="148" r="14" fill="#64748B"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="177" rx="25" ry="16" fill="#64748B"/>

  <line x1="219" y1="184" x2="233" y2="184" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- profile fields -->
  <text x="31" y="231" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Email</text>
  <rect x="31" y="241" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9"/>
  <text x="47" y="272" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">olivia.martin@email.com</text>

  <text x="31" y="316" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Date of birth</text>
  <rect x="31" y="326" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9"/>
  <text x="47" y="357" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">14 September 1992</text>
  <polyline points="338,347 343,352 348,347" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>

  <text x="31" y="401" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#0F172A">Phone number</text>
  <rect x="31" y="411" width="328" height="49" rx="10" fill="#F1F5F966" stroke="#F1F5F9"/>
  <text x="47" y="442" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">+33 6 42 18 75 90</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="492" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <text x="195" y="527" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Update Profile</text>
  </g>

  <text x="31" y="599" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Profile preferences</text>
  <line x1="31" y1="616" x2="359" y2="616" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="647" r="16" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="642" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="653" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="78" y="653" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#0F172A">Personal information</text>
  <polyline points="341,643 346,648 341,653" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="675" x2="359" y2="675" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="706" r="16" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="706" x2="54" y2="706" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="701" x2="49" y2="711" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="78" y="712" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#0F172A">Add another vehicle</text>
  <polyline points="341,702 346,707 341,712" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.7"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="796" x2="390" y2="796" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="35,814 43,807 51,814 51,823 46,823 46,817 40,817 40,823 35,823" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="43" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="118" cy="814" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="809" x2="118" y2="819" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="113" y1="814" x2="123" y2="814" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="118" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Garage</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="813" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#52B6DF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="811" r="2.5" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="818" rx="4.5" ry="2.5" fill="#52B6DF"/>
    <text x="195" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#52B6DF">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="267" y="807" width="16" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="271,820 274,817 277,820" fill="#64748B"/>
    <text x="275" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">Support</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="347" cy="812" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="818" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="812" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="818" r="2" fill="#64748B"/>
    <text x="344" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#64748B">More</text>
  </g>

  <!-- dimming overlay -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#334155" opacity="0.60"/>

  <!-- modal shadow and dialog -->
  <rect x="24" y="231" width="343" height="365" rx="25" fill="#000000" opacity="0.14"/>
  <rect x="24" y="227" width="343" height="365" rx="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- success illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="300" r="49" fill="#DCF0F9"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="300" r="32" fill="#52B6DF"/>
  <polyline points="178,300 190,312 214,287" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="236" cy="267" r="4" fill="#86CCE9"/>
  <circle cx="153" cy="328" r="3" fill="#86CCE9"/>
  <circle cx="242" cy="324" r="2.5" fill="#52B6DF"/>

  <text x="195" y="386" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0F172A">Profile updated</text>
  <text x="195" y="419" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">Your profile information has</text>
  <text x="195" y="443" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#64748B">been successfully updated.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="44" y="486" width="303" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#316D86" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="516" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#316D86">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <circle cx="346" cy="251" r="13" fill="#F1F5F9"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="246" x2="351" y2="256" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="351" y1="246" x2="341" y2="256" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>
